# Daily Report — 2026-10-02

## Task Completed
Added `list_hardware_assets` tool that queries the `alm_hardware` table (the dedicated hardware subclass of `alm_asset`). Returns both standard asset fields and hardware-specific fields (CPU count/cores/manufacturer/name/speed, disk space, RAM, OS/version/service pack/domain, MAC address, IP address). Supports optional filters for display_name, asset_tag, install_status, assigned_to, os, ip_address, and mac_address with full pagination support. Registered in service_desk, system_administrator, and full packages.
